asks: Which one are you listening to?
Can you hear the other one?
description: They're talking, and a half-second behind their mouth the words arrive again in a better order, from slightly to the left of them. Both versions are theirs.
emotes: {it} says something, and something behind {it} says it better.
{it} stops mid-sentence and lets the rest of it arrive on its own.
The two voices of {it} land on the same word at the same time, and {it} looks pleased.
looks: The second version is what they meant. The first is what they managed.
When they pause, the translation catches up and then waits, politely.
The gap between the two is exactly the length of a breath.
name: somebody being translated as they speak
says: I know. I heard it too.
The second one is the real one.
